text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-n-t t-h-r-e-a-t e-m-a-i-l s t-o t-e-n-a-n-t-s; d-r-a-f-t c-o-p-i-e-s w-e-r-e l-e-f-t i-n t-h-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t l-o-g-s; l-e-g-a-l c-o-u-n-s-e-l r-e-v-i-e-w w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d b-e-f-o-r-e d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n.
2) l-o-c-k-c-y-l-i-n-d-e-r-s w-e-r-e r-e-p-l-a-c-e-d w-h-i-l-e t-e-n-a-n-t-s w-e-r-e a-w-a-y; k-e-y f-i-t-t-i-n-g s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t-s r-e-m-a-i-n-e-d a-s e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e; o-c-c-u-p-a-n-c-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
3) e-l-e-c-t-r-i-c-i-t-y w-a-s d-i-s-c-o-n-n-e-c-t-e-d t-o a-p-p-l-y p-r-e-s-s-u-r-e; u-t-i-l-i-t-y b-i-l-l i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s p-r-o-v-e-d t-h-e c-u-t-o-f-f; r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
4) f-u-r-n-i-t-u-r-e w-a-s r-e-m-o-v-e-d a-n-d c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n-s d-e-t-e-r-i-o-r-a-t-e-d t-o c-r-e-a-t-e d-i-s-c-o-m-f-o-r-t; m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e r-e-q-u-e-s-t t-i-c-k-e-t-s s-t-a-y e-d o-p-e-n; h-a-b-i-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-o-g-g-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d-s i-n s-h-a-r-e-d n-o-t-e-s; t-h-e n-o-t-e f-i-l-e p-r-e-s-e-r-v-e-d t-h-e c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s; a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w w-a-s s-k-i-p-p-e-d f-o-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y.
